name: Callaloo and SaltFish
assumptions: Recipe serves 4 as a side dish based on total ingredient quantities (e.g. 227g salt cod + 525g callaloo + vegetables is typical for 4 portions).

Total active and passive preparation/cooking time estimated at 30 minutes: overnight soak excluded per standard recipe convention; includes ~10 min boil/drain, ~10 min skillet cooking steps, and ~10 min prep/chopping.
Bacon is treated as present for allergen/diet screening (pork-derived).
Salt cod (fish) is the only source of fish allergen; no cross-contamination assumed.
All other ingredients (vegetables, herbs, spices) are compatible with listed diets and free of listed allergens.
No gluten sources (no barley/rye/wheat/oats); no dairy; no eggs; no shellfish; no tree nuts; no peanuts; no soy; no sesame.
Pescatarian classification holds due to fish but no other meat beyond bacon (which disqualifies vegetarian/vegan).
instructions:
Soak salted fish in water overnight. Next, heat salted fish in water on stove until water boils. You should see a foam on top. Remove from heat and drain. Set aside and shred salted fish once it cools.
Cook bacon in skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove bacon from heat and drain the majority of the bacon grease, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the skillet. 
Add yellow onion, green onion, scotch bonnet pepper, and garlic to the skillet and stir. Cook for about 2 minutes or until onions soften. Add salted fish to skillet and stir. Cook for about a minute. 
Next, add callaloo, roma tomatoes, thyme, and black pepper. Stir to combine and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Enjoy

ingredients.name: Salt Cod
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 lb (227g) salt cod; typical values for soaked, boiled, drained, and shredded skinless boneless salt cod (bacalao); assumes majority of salt removed via overnight soak and boil per instructions; negligible carbs.

ingredients.name: Bacon
ingredients.assumptions: 4 slices (strips) of standard bacon, ~29g each; typical pan-fried values; most fat rendered out during cooking but full raw nutrient profile used as conservative estimate for the ingredient line; drained majority of grease per instructions.

ingredients.name: Callaloo
ingredients.assumptions: Exactly 525g fresh callaloo (amaranth/Chinese spinach leaves and tender stems); typical values for raw edible portion; cooked briefly per instructions so minimal water loss assumed.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium-large yellow onion (110g edible chopped weight); standard onion nutrition.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 2 chopped spring/green onions (~15g each, white and green parts); typical values.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 2 average garlic cloves, minced (~6g total); typical raw garlic values.

ingredients.name: Scotch Bonnet
ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole scotch bonnet pepper, chopped (~15g; similar to habanero); typical fresh chili pepper values.

ingredients.name: Plum Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium plum/Roma tomatoes, chopped (~60g each); typical fresh tomato values.

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: 2 sprigs fresh thyme (~4g leaves and tender stem per sprig); typical fresh thyme values; assumes leaves stripped and used.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1/4 tsp ground black pepper (~0.5-1g); typical values scaled to 1g for conservatism; negligible overall contribution.
